title: Hotel listing
description: Data contract for one hotel record in data/hotels/<slug>.json. Enforced by scripts/lib/hotels.mjs (validateHotel). Only records with status 'verified' AND a complete verification block are ever published. Never invent any value: leave a field out rather than guess.

slug.description: URL slug: the profile is published at /hotels/<slug>/. Must not clash with a category or area slug.

name.description: Exact trading name as shown on the property.

status.description: draft = being researched (private). contacted = property contacted, details not yet confirmed (private). verified = every published field confirmed with the property (public).

placeholder.description: true ONLY for the design/test records in data/hotels-placeholder/. Placeholder records never appear on any Netlify URL.

priceBand.description: Broad band agreed with the property. Never a price: the site never shows prices or availability.

suitableFor.description: Audience tags confirmed with the property (e.g. family rooms or extra beds available).

facilities.description: Slugs from data/facilities.json. Only facilities confirmed by the property in writing/by phone or seen in person.

summary.description: Short factual description written by us. Never copied from another website.

geo.description: Coordinates of the property's verified map pin (used for directions).

googlePlaceId.description: Optional Google Maps place ID of the property (improves the directions link).

distances.description: Distances in km measured by us with a map tool. Omit anything not measured.

whatsapp.description: The hotel's own WhatsApp number (enquiry button target).

rights.description: Never use photos copied from OTAs, Google Maps or other websites.

permissionRef.description: Required for supplied/licensed photos: where the written permission is kept.

affiliateLinks.description: Shown only if the partner is enabled in data/affiliates.json and the link host is allowed.

tier.description: featured = paid placement, always labelled 'Featured · Paid'.

lastVerified.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) every published field was last confirmed. Only change it after re-checking.

history.description: Private notes on the listing's progress (never published).
